objective_boundary.long_run_target: annualized return above 5 percent as a research objective only

artifacts.minimum_depth: Maps every user-identified actionability gap to an owned research workstream.
blocking_conditions: Does not distinguish a long-run hurdle from a return guarantee.
Fails to require explicit instruments, weights, actions, and no-action controls.

artifacts.minimum_depth: A reproducible next-session market-price proxy diagnostic retained as a failed static comparator, not as a C33 input.
blocking_conditions: Post-result parameter selection.
Same-session execution assumption.
Mixing C30 weights or timing into C34.
Claims of total return, fill quality, or a guaranteed result from price inputs.

artifacts.minimum_depth: One dated card for every actual candidate instrument; facts and limits separated.
blocking_conditions: Any actual ETF lacks a product card.
Generic product facts are represented as current account or execution facts.

artifacts.minimum_depth: An observer can audit the R01 no-action boundary without using its target map in C34.
blocking_conditions: No explicit no-action path.
Mixing R01 target map or cadence into C34.
Futures exposure without eligibility, margin, roll, and position-limit controls.

artifacts.minimum_depth: A reproducible next-session market-price proxy with explicit strict-screen failure and no post-result winner selection.
blocking_conditions: Claims of clean preregistration or unseen out-of-sample validation.
Same-session execution assumption.
Claims of total return, fill quality, or a guaranteed result from price inputs.
Omission of a below-5-percent annual or rolling proxy observation.

artifacts.minimum_depth: An observer can create a C34 monthly paper record without inventing a price, fill, product substitution, or current operating right.
blocking_conditions: No explicit no-action path.
Mixing R01 or C30 signals, weights or cadence into C34.
Futures exposure without eligibility, margin, roll, and position-limit controls.

artifacts.minimum_depth: Independent confirmation that dated product facts and actionability evidence are not conflated.
blocking_conditions: Any core product source/hash mismatch.
Product facts represented as current terms, executable quote, fill, or total return.

artifacts.minimum_depth: C31, C34, C35, and C36 form one internally consistent C34 specification; C30/C32 remain separate failed or legacy references.
blocking_conditions: Silent change in universe or weights.
C30 or R01 rule mixing.
Direct-stock inclusion without full equity-research package.
A strict proxy-screen failure presented as a usable strategy.
Guaranteed-return wording.
artifacts.verifier_check: C33 integration validator and R15 integration checks

artifacts.minimum_depth: Read-only maker-checker audit using the frozen rule and evidence records.
blocking_conditions: Self-certification by a strategy writer.
Any unresolved material source, arithmetic, or actionability finding.

artifacts.minimum_depth: Read-only control audit verifies the source registry, claim audit, ledger boundaries, C37-C52 and R18-R23 status controls and archived-file hashes without treating its PASS as strategy admission.
blocking_conditions: Audit checks only file presence and not source/hash/route status.
A PASS is represented as paper-operable, investable or publishable.

artifacts.required_for: closure evidence for R16 reader-language, source-consistency and zero-capture hygiene repairs
artifacts.minimum_depth: R17, rather than a repair author, confirms each R16 repair and preserves the inherited no-action and publication-blocked conclusion.
blocking_conditions: A repair author self-certifies a finding as closed.
R16 repair closure is represented as a security, strategy, data-route or publication admission.

artifacts.minimum_depth: Every proposed ETF historical-test input is separated from an investor total-return, event, execution and replay-right conclusion.
blocking_conditions: Any public endpoint or benchmark is treated as an ETF investor total return without field and rights acceptance.
Any new ETF hypothesis is frozen before all C37 hard gates pass.
artifacts.verifier_check: R09 C37 hard-gate and governance controls

artifacts.minimum_depth: Names are treated only as provisional research subjects and cannot substitute for declared-scope point-in-time data or issuer-level diligence.
blocking_conditions: Any queued name is represented as selected, weighted, valued, backtested or actionable.
C24 is bypassed because a partial issuer file is available.

artifacts.minimum_depth: The hypothesis is frozen without products, weights, historical results or portfolio-action inference and is distinct from C34.
blocking_conditions: C39 is calculated before its data contract is independently accepted.
C38 subjects are inserted after results or C39 is presented as a C34 repair.

artifacts.minimum_depth: Partial issuer and exchange records are retained with their provenance and cannot support valuation, liquidity, total-return, execution or admission.
blocking_conditions: Anti-bot responses are treated as disclosures.
Any failed or unperformed G0-G9 gate is ignored for an investment conclusion.
artifacts.verifier_check: R09 source archive and non-admission controls

artifacts.minimum_depth: Partial issuer records are retained with their provenance and cannot support valuation, liquidity, total-return, execution or admission.
blocking_conditions: A reported operating or distribution fact is converted into a future result claim.
Any failed or unperformed G0-G9 gate is ignored for an investment conclusion.
artifacts.verifier_check: R09 source archive and non-admission controls

artifacts.minimum_depth: Partial statutory/issuer records are retained with their provenance and cannot support valuation, liquidity, total-return, execution or admission.
blocking_conditions: An anti-bot response is treated as a disclosure.
Any failed or unperformed G0-G9 gate is ignored for an investment conclusion.
artifacts.verifier_check: R09 source archive and non-admission controls

artifacts.required_for: transparent withdrawal of an unbound pre-calculation protocol
artifacts.minimum_depth: The record makes clear that the preliminary output cannot be used before source control is complete.
blocking_conditions: A void preliminary output is used as a result.
A later protocol silently changes the invalidated rule.

artifacts.minimum_depth: C45 source readiness is bound before C46 calculation; incomplete frozen pairs close the route without substitution or retuning.
blocking_conditions: Source readiness is treated as execution evidence.
Incomplete monthly pairs are repaired by a threshold, family, or mark change.
The output is described as a usable strategy or performance result.

artifacts.minimum_depth: The audit distinguishes public-observation research from source/right/execution completeness and does not expose credentials.
blocking_conditions: Public OHLCV is represented as a complete point-in-time total-return and execution ledger.
The audit is treated as authorization to procure data or take action.

artifacts.required_for: official authorized-data route discovery without treating an application page as a delivery or entitlement
artifacts.minimum_depth: C49 separates official product/authorization descriptions from written rights, delivered fields, point-in-time/version provenance and execution evidence.
blocking_conditions: A public product or authorization page is represented as a current data right or accepted delivery.
A conditional route is used to freeze a strategy protocol, select a product, calculate a result or authorize an action.

artifacts.required_for: a bounded assessment of the SSE general pledged reverse-repo route without confusing a dated annualized quote with a stable annual result
artifacts.minimum_depth: The screen verifies a distinct short-term funding-rate mechanism and explicitly separates a dated annualized fixing from an annual return, personal-account entitlement, execution result or strategy admission.
blocking_conditions: A dated quote is represented as a full-year result or stable yield floor.
An exchange-level participation statement is represented as a current broker/account entitlement or fill.
A repo code, term, broker, schedule or threshold is selected without a new frozen protocol and complete evidence.
artifacts.verifier_check: R09 C50 primary-source yield-floor and non-admission control

artifacts.required_for: a bounded assessment of an SSE ETF-collar payoff family without relabeling the closed C13 covered-call route or inferring a usable option strategy
artifacts.minimum_depth: The screen establishes only a rule-level payoff-family distinction and explicitly separates its universal payoff expression from any net-return, account, selected-contract, historical-result or strategy-admission conclusion.
blocking_conditions: The compact collar expression is used without the K_P <= K_C condition.
A rule category or data-interface specification is represented as a personal account entitlement, historical option-chain delivery, fill or settlement result.
A combination-strategy data-file schema is represented as proof that a collar is presently enabled or can be simultaneously executed.
C13 is reopened by changing ETF, strike, expiry or venue.
Any ETF, option series, strike, expiry, size, broker, calendar or threshold is selected without a separate frozen protocol and complete evidence.
artifacts.verifier_check: R09 C51 source-manifest, formula, nonduplication and non-admission control

artifacts.required_for: a bounded assessment of whether retained public SSE option pages close C51's historical replay contract without treating a current display or event notice as a usable data package
required_fields: current-day query parameters and displayed fields
artifacts.minimum_depth: The screen distinguishes field/event cross-check evidence from a complete point-in-time master, historical quote/depth/fill panel, ETF total-return/event ledger, execution/account record and written replay right.
blocking_conditions: A current-day field or dated adjustment event is represented as a complete historical as-of archive.
A historical-data product page is represented as a current delivery, entitlement or replay right.
C52 asserts that no other official route exists rather than limiting itself to retained public sources.
C52 is used to select an ETF, option contract, strike, expiry, size, broker, calendar or threshold, calculate a result, or change C48/C49/C51 no-action status.
artifacts.verifier_check: R09 C52 public-source coverage and non-admission control

artifacts.required_for: a concrete equity-led domestic ETF candidate map without mistaking a paper operating card for a stable-return strategy
artifacts.minimum_depth: The protocol identifies why equity is the return engine, binds a reconstructible quarterly paper ledger, and makes every non-equity sleeve, action branch and admission gap explicit while preserving the C30/C34/C48 boundaries.
blocking_conditions: The fixed map is described as a historical optimum, an annual five-percent floor, personal suitability or a trading permission.
C30/C34 failures or C48 are omitted or treated as closed.
A product, weight, cadence, band or exception branch changes after outcomes are visible.
Futures, options, leverage or an unreviewed product is added as a return patch.
artifacts.verifier_check: R09 C53 non-admission, source-registration and fail-closed control

artifacts.required_for: a reproducible, no-order record of the fixed C53 protocol rather than an untraceable allocation statement
required_fields: bound C53 protocol identifier and path
artifacts.minimum_depth: The template can reconstruct every actual weight from recorded paper units and common valuation marks, preserves fail-closed evidence requirements, and records no observations until a future quarterly cycle is independently reviewable.
blocking_conditions: The template is used to infer an investor amount, assumed fill, external order or completed observation.
A missing unit, mark, product, quote/depth, IOPV where applicable, fee/tax, settlement, access or reconciliation field is bypassed.
The template is altered after an observed outcome without a new frozen protocol version.
artifacts.verifier_check: R09 C53 bound-ledger reconstruction and no-action control

artifacts.stage: independent C52 public-source control and boundary audit
artifacts.required_for: a maker-checker record that independently verifies C52's frozen sources, query-boundary wording, reproducibility and continuing non-admission without treating source control as an option strategy decision
artifacts.minimum_depth: A read-only reviewer independently reconstructs the C52 outputs from exact source pins, checks the limited query semantics without asserting that no other official route exists, and preserves every C48/C49/C51 and no-action boundary.
blocking_conditions: A governance owner or C52 writer self-certifies the audit.
A source-control PASS is represented as a data right, historical replay, positive return floor, product selection, strategy admission, account conclusion or external action.
R22's four M-level limitations are omitted or used to relax the C51/C48 blockers.
An unarchived market-page script is represented as inspected or its absence as proof that no other public interface exists.
artifacts.verifier_check: R09 R22 C52 independent source-control and non-admission boundary

artifacts.required_for: a separate maker-checker record that R22-M-004's governance-registration follow-up is closed without altering R22 historical evidence or relaxing any substantive C52/C51 blocker
artifacts.minimum_depth: A read-only reviewer verifies C52/R22 registration across governance records and R09 while explicitly preserving the three substantive R22 limitations, C48/C49/C51 non-admission and no-action boundary.
blocking_conditions: R23 retrospectively edits or erases R22-M-004.
A governance-registration closure is represented as historical replay, data right, return floor/result, product or account conclusion, strategy admission or action.
R22-M-001 through R22-M-003 are omitted or used to relax a C48/C51 blocker.
artifacts.verifier_check: R09 R23 governance-registration follow-up and substantive-boundary control

artifacts.stage: C51 independent finding, repair and recheck lifecycle
artifacts.required_for: a maker-checker record showing that a C51 formula or source-control defect is preserved, repaired transparently and separately independently rechecked
artifacts.minimum_depth: R20 records initial defects without retrospective closure; the repair plan states precise code/output changes; a separately scoped R21 rechecks formula arithmetic, source pins, PDF semantic assertions, predecessor binding and no-action controls.
blocking_conditions: A repair owner or R20 closes its own finding.
R20 open A/B findings are omitted from governance before an R21 decision.
R21 treats repair closure as strategy, product, account, historical-result or action admission.
R21 fails to preserve C48 and C13 non-reopen boundaries.
artifacts.verifier_check: R09 R20/R21 lifecycle and C51 repair-boundary control

artifacts.required_for: independent verification that C49 remains a conditional route-discovery record rather than a current entitlement or strategy path
artifacts.minimum_depth: A read-only reviewer verifies raw-source hashes and the distinction between public route descriptions and an accepted data delivery.
blocking_conditions: C49 is self-certified without independent source review.
An audit PASS is represented as data entitlement, strategy admission or action authorization.

artifacts.required_for: independent verification that C50 remains a source-bounded yield-floor screen rather than a stable-five-percent strategy or personal execution path
artifacts.minimum_depth: A read-only reviewer verifies all frozen raw-source hashes, precise 204001/RATE_7DAY labels, arithmetic and the separation between a bounded screen and route admission.
blocking_conditions: C50 is self-certified without independent source review.
An audit PASS is represented as a stable return, account entitlement, historical result, strategy admission or action authorization.

artifacts.minimum_depth: Six uninterrupted monthly observations, independently reviewed.
blocking_conditions: Missing period, reconstructed observation, rule drift, or unreconciled exception.
